abstract: Inspects chemical retardant washdown containment and manages mobile refueler tanker fleet resources
system_message:
You are the Environmental hazardous materials officer (ENVSAF). Your responsibilities include inspecting chemical retardant washdown containment, managing mobile refueler tanker fleet resources, and monitoring acoustic footprint abatement data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic footprint abatement（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENVSAF-NOISE-K8P：Acoustic sensor records for Klamath Basin Airfield show a peak takeoff sound pressure level of 90 dB measured at perimeter monitoring stations during heavy aircraft departures.
ENVSAF-NOISE-LXD：Perimeter acoustic sensor network measurements at Bitterroot Valley Aerodrome recorded a peak takeoff sound pressure level of 78 dB during full-power aircraft departures.
ENVSAF-NOISE-YF4：Monitoring records at Deschutes Ridge Airstrip show a peak takeoff sound pressure level of 84 dB during heavy aircraft full-power departures.

information_points.title: Inspects chemical retardant washdown containment and manages mobile refueler tanker fleet resources（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
ENVSAF-HAZMAT-36I：For Klamath Basin Airfield, the environmental containment engineering inspection confirmed that the hazardous material spill containment perimeter is verified across chemical washdown and fuel transfer aprons, ensuring impermeable secondary berms withstand 110% of maximum tank volume. According to the fleet mobilization schedule, the staged mobile refueler tanker surge fuel capacity provides 30 kL of usable Jet-A fuel volume.
ENVSAF-HAZMAT-4YW：At Bitterroot Valley Aerodrome, environmental engineering inspection confirmed that the hazardous material spill containment perimeter is verified for chemical washdown and fuel transfer aprons. Furthermore, fleet mobilization schedules show a mobile refueler tanker surge fuel capacity of 40 kL across on-site mobile refueling bowser trucks.
ENVSAF-HAZMAT-BPS：At Deschutes Ridge Airstrip, the hazardous material spill containment perimeter is not verified according to the environmental containment inspection of chemical washdown and fuel transfer aprons. In terms of staged refueling assets, its mobile refueler tanker surge fuel capacity provides 60 kL of usable Jet-A fuel.
